column1: # Named exceptions of network guard G2 (scripts/check-network-guards.py).
# A file named here may hold a NetworkPolicy, CiliumNetworkPolicy or CiliumClusterwideNetworkPolicy
# outside the policy chart. It is not part of the baseline, which may only shrink: an exception stays
# while its reason holds. One line per file: <path><TAB><owner package><TAB><reason>. No wildcards.
# The check fails when a named file no longer holds a policy kind. A package adds a line here only
# for an object that its own work defines, with its own identifier as the owner.

column3: The deny-egress object of the sovereignty proof (cutover step 08). It must deny egress for the proof to hold, so it is not an allow rule of the policy chart.
